module: Flowgraph node "In Zone" (repeat_instant, sites color). Detects whether a vehicle (vehId) is inside the zones of sitesData: tests points of the oriented spawn bounding box (getSpawnWorldOOBB) with sites:getZonesForPosition, publishes inside, and draws the zones in debug (pulsing red if outside, white if inside).
notes: Bug: work reads self.pinIn.flow, but no input pin "flow" is declared in pinSchema; self.pinIn.flow is therefore nil and indexing it raises a Lua error.
Bug: the loop `for i = 0, 8` always tests oobb:getPoint(0) instead of getPoint(i).
The sitesData pin has no tableType.

_executionStarted.desc: Initializes the red and white drawing colors.

work.desc: Tests whether the vehicle is in a zone, draws the zones in debug and writes inside.
